description: Replace ALL stored variables of one profile with `variables` - not a merge: names you omit are deleted, {} clears them. Names are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, at most 64 variables, values up to 32 KiB. They are delivered only to runs of APPROVED scripts (run_batch, schedules, and run_script once the user has approved the script) as process.env.VEILUS_VAR_<NAME>; a run_script trial of an unapproved script gets only the variables passed to that call. A variable passed to the run itself wins on the same name. Returns the stored names, never the values.

variables.description: The complete new set of variables

name: set_profile_variables
